Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes, and I want the zero withdrawn.
I didn't come for thanks. Why did my son find out about this from his phone, in the middle of class?
I'm sorry? I have a client call in twenty minutes. Owen. Why wasn't I called before that zero went in?
If you need to stop, stop. Otherwise, Owen: procedure 4.2 says you call me before a mark goes in. Did you?
